description: DCGM GPU Metrics for Kubernetes - with per-node/pod filtering, GPU health, and interconnect monitoring

targets.expr: avg(DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod"} / (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod"}) * 100)

DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod"} / (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod"}) * 100

DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod"} / (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{namespace=~"$namespace", node=~"$node", pod=~"$pod"}) * 100

panels.description: NVLink TX bytes per second. Critical for PD disaggregated deployment — monitors KV-cache transfer bandwidth between prefill and decode nodes.
panels.title: NVLink TX Bandwidth

panels.description: NVLink RX bytes per second. Critical for PD disaggregated deployment — monitors KV-cache transfer bandwidth between prefill and decode nodes.
panels.title: NVLink RX Bandwidth

panels.description: PCIe replay count — non-zero values may indicate hardware issues or signal integrity problems.
panels.title: PCIe Replay Counter

panels.description: ECC Single-Bit Errors (Volatile). Non-zero is usually OK but worth watching for trends.
panels.title: ECC Single-Bit Errors (Volatile)

panels.description: ECC Double-Bit Errors (Volatile) — uncorrectable errors. ANY non-zero value indicates a hardware problem that may cause incorrect computation. Investigate immediately.
panels.title: ECC Double-Bit Errors (Volatile) ⚠️

panels.description: XID errors reported by the GPU driver. Common XID codes: 31=GPU memory page fault, 43=GPU stopped processing, 48=Double-bit ECC, 63=ECC page retirement, 79=GPU fallen off bus.
panels.title: XID Errors

title: DCGM GPU Metrics (K8s)
